_comment: skill name -> exact training prompt. The orchestrator can only pick a name from here. 'scene' and 'pickup' are plain-language hints for the vision checks; edit them to match your table.

scene.bin: the designated bin: the white foam box on the right side of the table in the front_wide view
scene.camera: front_wide shows the whole table, with the robot at the top and the bin on the right

bottle.prompt: pick up the bottle and put it in the designated bin
bottle.pickup: bottles start on the table in the pick-up area (left and middle of the table), not in the bin
bottle.looks_like: a plastic drinks bottle (EDIT: describe your bottle, e.g. a green and white water bottle, standing or lying)

towel.prompt: pick up the towel and put it in the designated bin
towel.pickup: the towel starts on the table in the pick-up area (left and middle of the table), not in the bin
towel.looks_like: a cloth towel, flat or loosely folded (EDIT: describe your towel)
